title: Frequency of Cancer Drug List Reviews and Updates
what_it_is: Frequency of Cancer Drug List Reviews and Updates

sections.label: Cancer Drug List prices and listings
sections.summary: The CDL reduced cancer drug prices by an average of 30%, lists 400 drug-indication pairings, and MediFund aids unlisted drugs case by case.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since the implementation of the CDL, we have managed to reduce cancer drug prices by an average of 30%, and up to 60% for some drugs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH updates the CDL three times a year, in consultation with an expert committee comprising cancer specialists from public and private sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Through this process, we have listed 400 drug-indication pairings, which is comparable to all the pairings approved in 2022, before CDL was implemented.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For patients that require cancer drugs not yet listed on CDL, there are avenues for financial assistance in public healthcare institutions on a case-by-case basis through MediFund.

sections.label: ACE horizon scanning for drugs
sections.summary: ACE conducts horizon scanning to track approved overseas drugs and identify priority drugs with the Cancer Drug Sub-committee.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: On the question about tracking, yes, the Agency for Care Effectiveness (ACE) conducts horizon scanning to track approved drugs overseas and proactively identify priority drugs in consultation with the Cancer Drug Sub-committee and also engage companies to encourage them to put in the submissions.

sections.label: Clinician requests for rare cancers
sections.summary: Clinicians may submit requests to ACE for rare cancer treatments, and administrative burden processes could be streamlined separately.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In certain instances, yes, the clinicians may directly submit requests to ACE to evaluate treatments for potential inclusion in the CDL.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This is intended largely for treatments for very rare cancers, for example, where there are fewer than five to 10 patients per year where the treatment is not Health Sciences Authority-registered due to the very small patient numbers, but there is clinical need and the treatment has been approved by at least one reference overseas regulatory authority.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I also note the separate point the Member made about the administrative burden that the doctors and clinicians have to undertake.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We could take that separately and we could see how best we could streamline those processes.
